title: Integer division truncates before scaling
description: A project-owned semantic review case where a percentage is computed as an integer quotient before multiplying, collapsing the result to 0 or 100.

expectedFindings.semanticSummary: passed / total truncates to 0 for any partial ratio before the * 100, so the percentage is almost always 0 (or 100); multiply before dividing as passed * 100 / total
